packMeta.name: VenueOps (SoftN + Forms)
packMeta.description: Turnkey venue hire & booking manager: space schedule with automatic time-overlap conflict detection and hourly fee calculation, spaces catalogue, setup & facilities checklists, hirer clients directory, payments & deposits ledger with HTML booking confirmations, and incidents/damage log. Includes the full-stack SoftN application plus 6 schema-matched FormLogic forms & management charts sharing the same live SQLite database.
